texts: Apprentices scrub the cauldrons with sand.

fields.sentence: Apprentices scrub the cauldrons with sand.

review.notes: Bare-plural habitual correctly takes the distributing rule at 0.9/0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase, the definite plural object is a group witness rather than a kind, Patient is right for scrub (cleaning changes the object), and 'with sand' is an Instrument substance kept as a bare constant.
